# 3D StoreLink

> 3D StoreLink is an enterprise-grade Web 3D & Augmented Reality (AR) model distribution and automated CAD conversion platform. It transforms complex CAD files (STP, STEP, STL, OBJ) into ultra-optimized Web GLB assets, enabling single-line iframe and script embed with zero plugins across e-commerce platforms (Shopify, WooCommerce, custom frameworks).

3D StoreLink provides high-performance 3D visualization, automated polygonal mesh decimation, Draco compression, and native mobile AR (Apple Quick Look USDZ & Android SceneViewer) for engineering, e-commerce, and industrial equipment manufacturers.

## Core Capabilities
- [CAD to Web GLB Automation](https://3dstorelink.com/en/upload): Instant conversion from industrial CAD formats (STEP, STP, STL, OBJ) to web-optimized GLB.
- [Zero-Plugin Web 3D Viewer](https://3dstorelink.com/en): High-fidelity PBR rendering powered by WebGL, WebXR, and Google Model-Viewer.
- [Cross-Platform Mobile AR](https://3dstorelink.com/en/blog/app-free-web-ar-apple-quick-look-google-sceneviewer-guide): Instant Augmented Reality projection on iOS (USDZ Quick Look) and Android (SceneViewer) via QR codes or direct mobile taps.
- [Single-Line E-Commerce Embed](https://3dstorelink.com/en/blog/how-to-embed-3d-models-shopify-woocommerce-guide): Seamless iframe integration for product pages, reducing return rates by up to 40% and increasing buyer engagement by 94%.

## Research, Benchmarks & Guides
- [3D StoreLink Engineering Blog & Benchmark Hub](https://3dstorelink.com/en/blog): In-depth research papers on 3D/AR conversion telemetry, CAD Draco geometry compression, and e-commerce return reduction.
- [2026 E-Commerce 3D & AR Conversion Benchmark Report](https://3dstorelink.com/en/blog/2026-ecommerce-3d-ar-conversion-and-return-benchmark): Rigorous telemetry analyzing 50,000+ interactions, +94% add-to-cart lift, and 40% return reduction.
- [Industrial CAD to WebGL & Draco Optimization Guide](https://3dstorelink.com/en/blog/industrial-cad-stp-step-webgl-draco-optimization-guide): Deep architectural breakdown of B-Rep tessellation, mesh decimation, and Draco quantization.
- [Shopify & WooCommerce 3D Embed Playbook](https://3dstorelink.com/en/blog/how-to-embed-3d-models-in-shopify-and-woocommerce): 30-second integration guide for e-commerce store managers.
- [App-Free Mobile Web AR Architecture](https://3dstorelink.com/en/blog/app-free-web-ar-apple-quick-look-and-sceneviewer-architecture): LiDAR anchoring, dynamic USDZ/GLB delivery, and desktop-to-mobile QR handoff.
- [Technical Comparison Matrix](https://3dstorelink.com/en/compare): Technical benchmark comparing WebGL/AR vs 2D photos and legacy 3D viewers.
- [3D & CAD Engineering Glossary](https://3dstorelink.com/en/glossary): Technical dictionary covering STEP, GLB, glTF 2.0, WebXR, USDZ, Draco Compression, LOD, and PBR.
